value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Bakersfield/Kern County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Demonstrated compliance with the Eligibility Checklist for expedited permitting
Completed Standard Electrical Plan (for proposed solar installations 10kW or smaller)
Roof plan showing roof layout, PV panels, and fire safety items (roof access point, code-compliant access pathways, PV fire classification, required labels/markings)

Completed expedited Structural Criteria with required documentation (or, for non-qualifying systems, structural drawings/calculations stamped and signed by a California-licensed civil or structural engineer)

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own 'PV Toolkit Document #1: Submittal Requirements Bulletin' (expedited residential solar permitting, systems 10kW or smaller), linked from the Building Division's Forms page.

value: On-site inspections can be scheduled by calling the City of Bakersfield Building Division at 661-326-4677, or electronically via the Click2Gov permit-info portal

inspection_steps.notes: Per the City's own 'PV Toolkit Document #1: Submittal Requirements Bulletin,' Section 5 (Inspections) — this is the City's PV-specific inspection-scheduling process, not a generic building-inspection page.
